title: Sheinbaum meets Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, calls it a 'new era' for Mexico-China ties
detail: On Nov 17 Sheinbaum met Xi Jinping in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC Leaders' Meeting. They discussed cooperation in science, technology, clean energy, water, health, agriculture and tourism, and expanding Mexican exports to China. Official statements did not mention Mexico's recent tariffs on Chinese goods. Sheinbaum said she would not let the meeting hinder trade talks with Washington, and told Xi Mexico hosts APEC in 2028.

sources.name: Chinese Embassy in the US (official readout)
